titles.title: Red Splashes with Line

credit_line: Sheldon Museum of Art, University of Nebraska–Lincoln, Gift of anonymous donor, U-4424.1991
description: A thin red stripe runs horizontally across the center of the image. Above the stripe are splotches of red paint that appear to have been dripped onto the paper. These elements contrast with the plain white, exposed paper surrounding them.
